title: Polish：拉取請求仍把舊反例列為未解決
detail: 公開說明仍寫 AC-4 FAILED: falsifier confounded；任務中的 Captain amendment 1 已改用 AC-7，新的獨立重跑也通過。這是審查說明落後，未改變候選產品行為。
fix: 由 FO 在呈現驗收前更新說明，保留舊反例為歷史限制。
normal_workflow: Reviewer opens PR #800 before validation gate.
observable_harm: Obsolete evidence status may confuse review; no demonstrated loss in product behavior.
boundary: none: not a candidate acceptance defect; accepted amendment is correctly retained in task state.
trigger: validation/pr-800.json body contains Open evidence limit and FAILED for superseded AC-4.

title: Polish：觀察者在同份報告內撤回誤標
detail: 原始報告先寫 violation，隨即明確撤回並給出正確的 ok 行；完整原文保留。AC-5 以最終有效判定評估，並非宣稱原文完全沒有 violation 字樣。
fix: FO 呈現時保留撤回與更正的上下文；不再重跑觀察者。
normal_workflow: FO reads the bounded observer report.
observable_harm: Draft label may confuse a skim; the same response explicitly withdraws it.
boundary: none: final active interpretation matches the changed rule; literal raw-output cleanliness is not claimed.
trigger: Explicit withdrawal and superseding ok line in the retained final candidate report.
